About PicoBoi

PicoBoi is an open-source experiment by @farilyaz in running small language models directly inside a website, on your own device.

Explore the code on GitHub ↗

What can PicoBoi do?

The first model, PicoBoi-100K, has 99,120 parameters, an 800-word vocabulary and a 128-token context. Try simple vocabulary, counting or sentence examples. It is a limited experiment: replies can be wrong.

Where does the model run?

The language model runs in a worker in your browser, on your device. Chat inference does not require a remote AI service. Model files are downloaded when you open the chat.

Are conversations saved?

This page keeps conversations in memory and does not save chat history. Reloading the page or starting a new chat clears the conversation. Optional web lookups send search terms to Wikipedia; disable “Look up unfamiliar topics” to keep those terms on your device.

How can I explore the project?

The public GitHub repository contains the browser app, model files and training code. You can inspect the implementation and run it locally.
